provenance.source_document: SRMIST B.Tech Regulation 2021 Curriculum & Syllabus - 21MAB201T Transforms and Boundary Value Problems
provenance.notes: Authoritative 5-unit syllabus covering partial differential equations, Fourier series, one-dimensional boundary value problems, two-dimensional heat equations, and Fourier transforms.
